title: errbudget 1.2.1: choosing the numerical parameters of a black-box solver for a target accuracy in one observable

creators.name: Kabacaoğlu, Gökberk
creators.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Durham University

description: Python program that chooses mesh, time step, nested-solver tolerances and cost-only settings of a black-box solver so that one scalar observable meets a target accuracy, with a per-parameter error budget. The deposit contains the package, the tests, the solver outputs of every run reported in the accompanying article, the pre-registration of the held-out tests, the scripts that regenerate every table and figure, and the Slurm kit for the cluster studies.
